summary: Build practical NGO board governance skills in five days. Strengthen risk, safeguarding, finance, and impact oversight. Enquire today.
lede: Board governance training for NGOs helps board members and senior leaders connect mission oversight with risk, resources, and accountability. Participants assess governance arrangements, map board and management responsibilities, and build risk registers and dashboards for financial, programme, and safeguarding oversight. They also practise interpreting indicators, recording decisions, and tracking actions to support accountable decisions and credible mission reporting.
audienceIntro: Board governance for NGOs requires people who can connect mission, oversight, risk, resources, and stakeholder accountability. This course suits professionals with existing exposure to NGO operations, board processes, finance, programmes, compliance, or organisational leadership.
modules: Board Roles and IIA Three Lines
prerequisites: You should have experience with NGO governance, programme delivery, finance, compliance, risk, or senior organisational management. Prior board service is useful but not required. No coding or programming is required. You should bring access to a laptop for spreadsheet-based exercises. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted board reporting and digital compliance workflows are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, not technical engineering levels.
